note: Rewritten from Silvestri's original description of 1914 (in Latin), published as Hoplognathotermes submissus sp. n., where the author expressly notes 'Imago et miles ignota' (alate and soldier unknown); only the two worker size classes are therefore described; type locality Victoria, Cameroon. The original uses a comma as the decimal separator; the measurements have been transcribed as 1.25, 1.32 and so on.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The major worker differs from the preceding species of the genus in the smaller size, the sides of the lower part of the head and the lateral and median areas behind the clypeus more or less blackish, the antennae 14-segmented (segment 2 about 1/4 longer than segment 3, segment 3 about 1/3 longer than segment 4, segment 5 again about 1/6 longer than segment 4) and the mandibular teeth acute and rather long. Neither the alate nor the soldier was found by the author.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Major worker: body length 6 mm; head length 1.25 mm; head width 1.32 mm; antennal length 1.82 mm; hind tibia length 1.40 mm. Mandibular teeth acute and rather long. Minor worker: antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 about 1/3 longer than segment 3, segment 3 about 1/3 longer than segment 4. Body length 5.5 mm; head length 1.17 mm; head width 1.25 mm; antennal length 1.82 mm; hind tibia length 1.32 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Locality and habits: Victoria, Cameroon; a few workers taken in galleries beneath the trunk of a large tree.
